```{r setup}
library(delaydistribution)
```

## Overview

`delaydistribution` provides methods to compute delay distributions from
summary statistics (e.g. a reported mean and standard deviation).

This vignette is a **placeholder** that will be expanded once the main
analysis functions have been added to the package.

## Planned workflow

1. Supply summary statistics describing the delay (mean, SD, or quantiles).
2. Choose a parametric family (e.g. log-normal, gamma, Weibull).
3. Fit the distribution — either analytically or via a Stan model stored in
   `inst/stan/`.
4. Inspect and use the fitted distribution.
